title: Active Brake Warranty Limit per Axle and Supersession by a New Paid Job
content:
## Clause

1. Brake Service Warranties are aggregated per axle of a vehicle. An axle may carry only one active brake warranty at a time; the cap is the line's number of active warranties per axle.
2. When a new paid brake job is done on an axle that already has an active warranty, the older warranty is superseded on the date of the new job and the new job's warranty starts.
3. A warranty replacement is not a new paid job and never supersedes anything: pads installed under warranty keep the original job's warranty.

## Evidence of an active warranty on the axle

Whether an axle already carries an active warranty is decided from the company's warranty records, as they stand before the new job is recorded — not from the customer's account of it. The object compared is the same vehicle and the same axle (front or rear): a warranty on the other axle of the same vehicle, or on the same axle of another vehicle, is a different axle. Each paid job is its own warranty, distinguished by its own service date.

## Input, judgement, result

| Records for this vehicle and axle | Work done | Result |
|---|---|---|
| An active brake warranty | a new paid brake job | the older warranty is superseded on the date of the new job; the new job's warranty starts |
| No active brake warranty | a new paid brake job | the new job's warranty starts; there is no active warranty on the axle to supersede |
| An active brake warranty | a warranty pad replacement | nothing is superseded; the existing warranty continues with the original job's warranty |

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

A vehicle carries an active warranty on its front axle from an earlier paid job and an active warranty on its rear axle. On a hypothetical date D, a new paid brake job is done on the front axle. The front warranty from the earlier job is superseded on D and the new front job's warranty starts on D. The rear warranty is on a different axle and is untouched. Had the front-axle work on D been a warranty pad replacement instead, the earlier front warranty would have stayed active with its original dates.
